## Summary

**Scenario:** `scenario-873541e3b10c332d` — 30 s node-backend waypoint run, vehicle-c-azimuth (Dual-azimuth overactuated USV) on the `coupled6` plant, single waypoint at 20 m north / 0 m east.

**Run result:** `run-4881a951-a17b-438f-b5a2-1181d68c0b4a` — success

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Completion time | 14.4 s (144 steps @ 0.1 s) — mission completed well before the 30 s budget, so the sim terminated early rather than running the full duration |
| Propulsion energy | 4.018 J (units per sim convention) |
| Total sensor cost | 77.04 |
| Total energy (propulsion + sensor) | 81.058 |

Note: sensor cost is nonzero even though no sensors were explicitly configured in this scenario — that figure reflects whatever default/oracle sensor accounting the backend applies; flagging this since it dominates total_energy over propulsion.

**Evidentiary status (important caveat):** vehicle-c-azimuth's validation status is **"allocation-demonstrated-dynamics-unvalidated"** — the preset's control-allocation/composability behavior has been demonstrated, but its underlying behavioral dynamics on the `coupled6` plant have **not** been independently validated. This means the trajectory-tracking and energy numbers above should be treated as a functional/allocation demonstration, not as validated physical performance data. Do not use this run's propulsion or motion metrics as evidence of real-world dynamic accuracy without further independent validation of the vehicle model.
